items.description: The populist right-wing leader of 12 years says it is "clear" his party has lost the vote billed as a referendum on the country's future.

items.title: India news: Rahul Gandhi urges protest against voter deletions, announces November 1 rally
items.description: India's opposition leader Rahul Gandhi has accused the ruling BJP of "vote theft" and urged people to join a rally in Delhi on November 1. The call comes amid protests over revision of electoral rolls. DW has more.
